summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC for BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2025-5C37, an asset-backed securities issuing entity. The filing reports the removal of Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer of the 1000 Portside Drive Mortgage Loan and appointment of Torchlight Loan Services, LLC as successor special servicer under the BMARK 2025-V17 PSA, effective July 8, 2026. This is a routine servicing transfer event for a securitized commercial mortgage loan, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change.
